versions.subject: Merge PR #4427 from @nasbench - Multiple Fixes & Enhancements
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\brave.exe'
        - '\chrome.exe'
        - '\msedge.exe'
        - '\opera.exe'
        - '\vivaldi.exe'
selection_headless:
    CommandLine|contains: '--headless'
selection_url:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '://run.mocky'
        - '://mockbin'
condition: all of selection_*
